title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Put on the crown today, Greg
They decide whether they’re sticking you back on the beat or not?
No I don’t think I’m getting it back

Got a meeting with Peter and union tomorrow, discipline baby. I think they might make me a general sports reporter. Then they’re going to say that I don’t want to work for Chris anymore and see where that goes
But as I speak now, I’m kind of coming up with a twitter thread because im not going to bite my tongue for much longer after this is cleared up
So I’ll certainly need your expertise in forming it once I get a rough draft
I know how much you love my tweet ideas but you know those videos from a distance of someone walking out of jail or something
Eh. That one wasn’t that funny now that I thought about it
But if someone tweeted at me saying @ are you dead?
Quote retweet it with . “Do I look like Al Avila to you? Child, please. “No comment.”
Or I could just return by wishing a happy birthday to @tigers
The last one would be lame. I’m not sure how you’d get someone to set you up for the Child, please comment but it would be an incredible landing
I was just going to go have my buddy do i
Ah, well that would be pretty good if it works out like that
